as_told.title: Marc Andreessen told whole areas of physics were classified in the Cold War

plain: According to several guests, the tech investors Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz met a staff member of the National Security Council who told them that whole areas of physics had once been classified. If that is true, the government has hidden basic science before. A guest named Matthew Pines, who calls it hearsay, quotes the staffer as saying "we have classified entire areas of fundamental physics before" and "don't think we can do the same for AI." Michels cites the meeting as corroboration of hidden physics, and he also points to an interview Andreessen gave the journalist Bari Weiss, where he says the investors were told only "two or three guys" would be allowed to work on AI. The researcher Eric Weinstein says they were told, "Do not invest in AI startups." A guest named Pippa Malmgren, who also credits Weinstein, adds that "many technologies, particularly in the nuclear space," were placed out of public reach.
